subject: general
question: Which of the following established by Raja Rammohan Roy was a precursor in socio-religious reforms in Bengal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Atmiya Sabha**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Atmiya Sabha** was established by **Raja Rammohan Roy** in **1815**.
 
• It was a precursor to socio-religious reforms in Bengal, aiming at** promoting free thinking, rationality, and social reform**.
 
• The Sabha played a significant role in the **abolition of practices like Sati and child marriage**, and in promoting women's rights.
 
• **Raja Rammohan Roy** is often regarded as the "**Father of the Indian Renaissance**" due to his efforts in modernizing Indian society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Prarthana Samaj** was founded later in **1867 **by** Dr. Atmaram Pandurang in Bombay**.
 
• **Arya Samaj** was founded by **Swami Dayananda Saraswati **in **1875**.
 
• **Dharma Sabha** was established by **Radhakanta Deb **in **1830 **as a conservative Hindu organization opposing Roy's reforms.
 
• Raja Rammohan Roy also founded the **Brahmo Samaj** in **1828**, which furthered his reformist agenda.
